g.text: R85=66.5k1%: TI table2 current-limit range351.2..448.7mA; this does not authorize USB pre-enumeration current.

g.desc: R85=66.5k1%: TI table2 current-limit range351.2..448.7mA; this does not authorize USB pre-enumeration current.

g.text: Firmware must meet USB100mA pre-configuration and suspend budgets. Boot current/compliance has NOT been demonstrated.

g.desc: Firmware must meet USB100mA pre-configuration and suspend budgets. Boot current/compliance has NOT been demonstrated.

g.text: Status and fault pull-ups are3V3; they are invalid while the core supply is absent. FAULT/ST are not power-good tests.

g.desc: Status and fault pull-ups are3V3; they are invalid while the core supply is absent. FAULT/ST are not power-good tests.

g.text: ST LOW = IN2 battery. ST HIGH = IN1 USB OR both sources invalid; always cross-check TP81/82/83.

g.desc: ST LOW = IN2 battery. ST HIGH = IN1 USB OR both sources invalid; always cross-check TP81/82/83.

g.text: C84 provides source-transition buffering; it is not an independent battery and not a quantified full-system hold time.

g.desc: C84 provides source-transition buffering; it is not an independent battery and not a quantified full-system hold time.

g.text: D3 USB-to-VLOGIC Schottky removed: no bypass around U10/U11. Camera rail attaches only to protected battery.

g.desc: D3 USB-to-VLOGIC Schottky removed: no bypass around U10/U11. Camera rail attaches only to protected battery.

g.text: VCOMP switch time100us is typical, NOT the5us fast-comparator mode and NOT a guaranteed worst case.

g.desc: VCOMP switch time100us is typical, NOT the5us fast-comparator mode and NOT a guaranteed worst case.

g.text: U11 IN1=USB_LIMITED, IN2=RAW_PROTECTED. PR1/CP2 low: VCOMP selects the higher input with hysteresis.
